##### DATA PREPROCESSING FOR OHRQOL OUTCOME ######

```{r}
## Dataset splitting
library(rsample)

set.seed(123)

OHQ_split <- initial_split(
  New_OHQ,
  prop = 0.80,
  strata = cluster
)

O_trainset <- training(OHQ_split)
O_testset  <- testing(OHQ_split)
```

```{r}
### Data preprocessing using recipes package for caries

OHQ_recipe <- recipe(cluster ~ .,data = O_trainset) %>%
    role_case(stratum = cluster) %>%
    step_rm(codigo,OHRQoL)%>%
    check_missing(cluster) %>%
    step_filter_missing(all_predictors(),threshold = 0.50) %>%
    step_nzv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_impute_knn(all_predictors())%>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.9) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
    

##prep the recipe
    OHQprep <- prep(OHQ_recipe, training = O_trainset)
    #OHQprep
##Bake the prepped recipes for both trainset and testset
    OHQ_baked_train <- bake(OHQprep, new_data = O_trainset)
    OHQ_baked_test  <- bake(OHQprep, new_data = O_testset)

#OHQ_baked_train
#OHQ_baked_test

```

####CROSSVALIDATION  AND TUNNING#####

```{r}
##crossvalidation
Control <- CVControl(folds = 5, seed = 123)
```

                ###########################Logistic regression##########################

```{r}
##Model tunning
set.seed(123)
MODEL<- TunedModel(GLMModel(family = binomial), control = Control)
```


```{r}
### Model fitting 
set.seed(123)

O_LOGFit <- fit(cluster ~ .,data = OHQ_baked_train, model = MODEL)

O_LOGres <- resample(cluster ~ .,data = OHQ_baked_train, model = MODEL, control = Control)

#summary(O_LOGFit)
#summary(O_LOGres)
```

##### RESAMPLE  ######
```{r}
O_perf_res_log <- performance(
  O_LOGres,
  metrics = c(
    "ROC AUC"     = "roc_auc",
    "PR AUC"      = "pr_auc",
    "Brier Score" = "brier",
    "Accuracy"    = "accuracy",
    "Sensitivity" = "sensitivity",
    "Specificity" = "specificity",
    "PPV"         = "ppv",
    "NPV"         = "npv",
    "F1"          = "f_score"
  )
)

#summary(O_perf_res_log)
```

##### PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT ON TESTSET ######
```{r }
#### Evaluate on the untouched 50% test set

# Observed test outcomes
obs_test <- response(O_LOGFit,newdata = OHQ_baked_test)

# Predicted probability of the second factor level,which should be the positive class
pred_test <- predict(O_LOGFit,newdata = OHQ_baked_test,type = "prob")
#pred_test

# Predicted classes using the default cutoff of 0.50
class_test <- predict(O_LOGFit,newdata = OHQ_baked_test,cutoff  = 0.50)
#class_test

# Test-set metrics
test_performance <- performance(obs_test,pred_test,
  metrics = c(
    "ROC AUC"     = "roc_auc",
    "PR AUC"      = "pr_auc",
    "Brier Score" = "brier",
    "Accuracy"    = "accuracy",
    "Sensitivity" = "sensitivity",
    "Specificity" = "specificity",
    "PPV"         = "ppv",
    "NPV"         = "npv",
    "F1"          = "f_score"
    ),
  cutoff = 0.50)

test_performance

# Test-set confusion matrix
table(Observed  = obs_test,Predicted = class_test)

```

positive_class <- "NO"

```{r}
X_train_XG <- OHQ_baked_train %>%
  select(-cluster)

X_test_XG <- OHQ_baked_test %>%
  select(-cluster)
```

```{r}
pred_wrapper_XG <- function(object, newdata) {
  
  pred <- predict(
    object,
    newdata = newdata,
    type = "prob"
  )
  
  # If predict() returns a matrix/data frame of probabilities
  if (is.matrix(pred) || is.data.frame(pred)) {
    
    pred <- as.data.frame(pred)
    
    # Use YES column if it exists
    if ("YES" %in% names(pred)) {
      return(as.numeric(pred[["YES"]]))
    }
    
    # Otherwise use probability for second factor level
    return(as.numeric(pred[[2]]))
  }
  
  # If MachineShop already returns probability of second level
  return(as.numeric(pred))
}
```

```{r}
pred_wrapper_XG(
  O_XGBFit,
  X_test_XG[1:10, , drop = FALSE]
)
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)

n_shap <- min(1000, nrow(X_test_XG))

shap_index <- sample(
  seq_len(nrow(X_test_XG)),
  size = n_shap,
  replace = FALSE
)

X_explain_XG <- X_test_XG[
  shap_index,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

SHAP_LOG <- fastshap::explain(
  object = O_XGBFit,
  X = X_train_XG,
  newdata = X_explain_XG,
  pred_wrapper = pred_wrapper_XG,
  nsim = 200,
  adjust = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
SHAP_XG_matrix <- as.matrix(SHAP_XG)

SHAP_XG_viz <- shapviz(
  SHAP_LOG_matrix,
  X = X_explain_XG
)
```


```{r}
sv_importance(
  SHAP_XG_viz,
  kind = "beeswarm",
  max_display = 20
)
```
